title: From Common Information to Canonical Correlation Analysis and Beyond: Bridging Information Theory, Signal Processing, and Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28978v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many problems in signal processing, machine learning, and neuroimaging provide several jointly observed measurements of one process, each mixing a component common to all of them with a component private to itself, and require the common component to be recovered without supervision. This problem has been studied in several communities, largely independently. Statisticians proposed canonical correlation analysis (CCA), introduced by Hotelling in 1936. Information theorists proposed two notions of common information, due to G\'acs and K\"orner and to Wyner. Engineers developed subspace methods for sensor arrays and multiuser communications to design multiview receivers. This tutorial presents the main results and tools each community developed for this problem in a single exposition, and explains the connections that emerge where they meet, distinguishing exact equivalences from special cases and analogies. translated_title: 从公共信息到典型相关分析及其延伸：连接信息论、信号处理与机器学习
translated_abstract: 信号处理、机器学习和神经成像中的许多问题提供了对同一过程的若干联合观测，每个观测将所有观测共有的分量与自身私有的分量混合在一起，并需要在无监督条件下恢复公共分量。这个问题在多个研究群体中得到了研究，且在很大程度上是相互独立的：统计学家提出了由Hotelling于1936年引入的典型相关分析（CCA）；信息论学者提出了两种公共信息的概念，分别源于Gács和Körner以及Wyner；工程师们为传感器阵列和多用户通信开发了子空间方法，以设计多视图接收器。本教程在单一的阐述中呈现了各研究群体为这一问题开发的主要结果和工具，并解释了它们交汇处涌现的联系，区分了精确等价关系与特殊情况和类比。我们发展了信息论……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 本教程首次将统计学中的典型相关分析、信息论中的两种公共信息概念以及工程领域的多视图子空间方法置于统一框架下，为无监督恢复多观测中公共分量的跨学科问题建立了桥梁，并厘清了不同理论之间的精确等价与类比关系。
en_tdlr: This tutorial provides the first unified exposition bridging canonical correlation analysis from statistics, the Gács-Körner and Wyner notions of common information from information theory, and multi-view subspace methods from engineering for the unsupervised recovery of common components in jointly observed measurements.
